# Tom's Guide
> Tom's Guide helps people choose the right tech, find the best deals, and solve everyday device problems.

Tom's Guide is a consumer technology publication covering product reviews, buying advice, news, deals, and practical how-to content across phones, computing, TVs, streaming, smart home, fitness, and online services.

## Main Sections
- [Home](https://www.tomsguide.com/): Front page featuring reviews, news, deals, and how-to stories across consumer tech.
- [Reviews](https://www.tomsguide.com/reviews): Product review hub for phones, laptops, TVs, appliances, and accessories.
- [Best Picks](https://www.tomsguide.com/best-picks): Buying guides and top recommendations across major tech categories.
- [How To](https://www.tomsguide.com/how-to): Step-by-step tutorials for apps, devices, streaming services, and troubleshooting.
- [Deals](https://www.tomsguide.com/deals): Curated discounts on tech products, subscriptions, and seasonal sales events.
- [News](https://www.tomsguide.com/news): Latest consumer tech news, launches, rumors, and service updates.
- [Streaming](https://www.tomsguide.com/entertainment/streaming): Coverage of streaming platforms, shows, movies, and viewing recommendations.
- [Wellness](https://www.tomsguide.com/wellness): Fitness, sleep, wearables, and health-focused product and service coverage.

## Phones
- [Phones](https://www.tomsguide.com/phones): Phones hub with smartphone news, reviews, buying guides, and comparisons.
- [Phone Reviews](https://www.tomsguide.com/phones/reviews): Expert reviews of iPhones, Android phones, and foldables.
- [Best Phones](https://www.tomsguide.com/best-picks/best-phones): Ranked recommendations for the best smartphones to buy now.
- [Phone Deals](https://www.tomsguide.com/phones/deals): Discounts and promotions on unlocked phones and carrier offers.
- [Phone Face-Offs](https://www.tomsguide.com/phones/face-off): Head-to-head comparisons between popular smartphone models and platforms.
- [Android Phones](https://www.tomsguide.com/phones/android-phones): Android phone coverage including Samsung, Pixel, OnePlus, and Motorola.
- [iPhone](https://www.tomsguide.com/phones/iphone): iPhone news, reviews, tips, and buying advice.
- [Network Carriers](https://www.tomsguide.com/phones/network-carriers): Carrier plans, MVNO comparisons, and wireless service guidance.

## Computing
- [Computing](https://www.tomsguide.com/computing): Laptops, tablets, software, accessories, and PC-related coverage.
- [Computing Reviews](https://www.tomsguide.com/computing/reviews): Reviews of laptops, tablets, monitors, keyboards, and peripherals.
- [Laptops](https://www.tomsguide.com/computing/laptops): Laptop news, reviews, comparisons, and buying advice.
- [Tablets](https://www.tomsguide.com/computing/tablets): Tablet reviews and guides covering iPads, Android tablets, and accessories.
- [Monitors](https://www.tomsguide.com/computing/monitors): Monitor reviews and recommendations for work, gaming, and home use.
- [Software](https://www.tomsguide.com/computing/software): Software news, app guides, and platform feature coverage.
- [VPN](https://www.tomsguide.com/computing/vpn): VPN reviews, comparisons, and privacy-focused recommendations.
- [Antivirus](https://www.tomsguide.com/computing/antivirus): Antivirus reviews and security software buying advice.

## TVs & Home Entertainment
- [TVs](https://www.tomsguide.com/tvs): TV reviews, buying guides, setup advice, and display technology news.
- [TV Reviews](https://www.tomsguide.com/tvs/reviews): Reviews of OLED, QLED, Mini-LED, and budget televisions.
- [Best TVs](https://www.tomsguide.com/best-picks/best-tvs): Top TV recommendations by size, budget, and use case.
- [Streaming Devices](https://www.tomsguide.com/tvs/streaming-devices): Coverage of Roku, Fire TV, Apple TV, and Google TV hardware.
- [Projectors](https://www.tomsguide.com/tvs/projectors): Projector reviews, comparisons, and home theater buying advice.
- [Soundbars](https://www.tomsguide.com/audio/soundbars): Soundbar reviews and recommendations for better TV audio.

- [Best Wireless Earbuds](https://www.tomsguide.com/best-picks/best-wireless-earbuds): Top wireless earbud picks across price points and platforms.
